headline: Kalshi halts Trump mention prediction contracts following CFTC order
summary: Prediction market operator Kalshi confirmed it complied with an order from the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission to halt contracts involving mentions of the U.S. president.
why: Kalshi is a CFTC-regulated event-contract prediction market exchange in the United States.

impacts.name: Kalshi
impacts.why: Regulatory intervention forces the exchange to remove revenue-generating contract offerings.
